title: Process Reward Models That Think
paper_type_zh: Rollout、搜索或测试时推理轨迹研究
best_for_zh: 需要审计测试时轨迹、反馈与选择机制的读者
one_line: ThinkPRM trains generative process verifiers on 1,000 QwQ-generated, PRM800K-label-filtered verification CoTs and spends additional verifier compute to score or select reasoning paths.
ThinkPRM 生成逐步验证推理，并把验证计算用于候选选择和奖励引导搜索。
why: It makes verifier reasoning a first-class test-time trace and shows how process-label filtering, score extraction, repeated verification, and search aggregation jointly determine candidate selection, while leaving rationale validity and release lineage as separate audit questions.
inclusion_reason: ThinkPRM exposes a concrete synthetic process-supervision object and a generative verifier whose reasoning, scalar score, parallel resampling, and sequential re-verification directly shape Best-of-N and search trajectories. It is relevant to rollout/search trace curation because verifier outputs and aggregation choices determine which candidate paths are retained even when the candidate generator is unchanged.

title: Problem
问题
html:
The arXiv v5 paper, official author repository and project page, public Hugging Face dataset and model releases, and the official OpenReview TMLR submissions listing are the primary sources for this Card. OpenReview lists the eight-author work as accepted by Transactions on Machine Learning Research in March 2026; arXiv records the original 2025 release.

Process reward models score partial solutions so that Best-of-N or search can favor promising reasoning paths. Conventional discriminative PRMs map a prefix directly to a score and commonly require hundreds of thousands of step labels. General-purpose LLM-as-a-Judge verifiers can instead generate explanations, but the paper finds frequent invalid labels, looping, overthinking, and weak error detection when reasoning models are used without verifier-specific training.

ThinkPRM asks whether a small, filtered synthetic dataset can turn an existing reasoning model into a generative process verifier. The released data object is a six-field training row: a PRM800K/MATH problem, a model-generated solution prefix, a QwQ-32B-Preview verification CoT, parsed prefix steps, human ground-truth step labels, and an overall prefix label. At inference the verifier produces a new verification trace and a scalar correctness score used to rank or expand candidate paths.

The work belongs in rollout_search_test_time_trace_data because verifier traces are generated inside Best-of-N and beam-search workflows, and parallel or sequential re-verification changes which candidate solutions are retained without changing the solution generator. The Card remains L3/partial because the dataset repository's MIT notice has an unfilled copyright placeholder and unclear upstream coverage, while code licensing, decontamination, rejected generations, exact upstream row IDs, the 65K expansion, and several reconstruction settings remain unavailable or unverified.

本卡以arXiv v5论文、作者官方代码仓库与项目页、公开Hugging Face数据集和模型发布，以及OpenReview官方TMLR submissions列表为主要来源。OpenReview将这篇八位作者的工作列为2026年3月被Transactions on Machine Learning Research接收；arXiv记录其最初发表于2025年。

Process reward model为部分解答评分，使Best-of-N或搜索能够优先保留更有希望的推理路径。传统判别式PRM把前缀直接映射为分数，通常需要数十万条步骤标签。通用LLM-as-a-Judge可以生成解释，但论文发现，未经验证器专门训练的推理模型经常出现无效标签、循环、overthinking和较弱的错误识别。

ThinkPRM研究能否用一个小型、经过过滤的合成数据集，把现有推理模型转化为生成式过程验证器。公开数据对象是六字段训练行：PRM800K/MATH题目、模型生成的解答前缀、QwQ-32B-Preview验证CoT、解析后的前缀步骤、人工ground-truth步骤标签和整体前缀标签。推理时，验证器产生新的验证轨迹和标量正确性分数，用于排序或扩展候选路径。

该工作适合rollout_search_test_time_trace_data，因为验证轨迹出现在Best-of-N和beam-search工作流内部，parallel或sequential re-verification会在不改变解答生成器的情况下改变保留的候选。数据仓虽新增MIT声明，但版权方占位符未填写且上游覆盖范围不清；代码许可、去污染、被拒绝生成、精确上游行ID、65K扩展和若干重建设置仍不可用或未核验，因此本卡保留L3/partial。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
ThinkPRM changes a process verifier from a prefix-to-scalar classifier into a verbalized judge. Given a math problem and solution prefix, the model generates a long verification CoT that critiques steps in order, emits a boxed correct or incorrect judgment for each reviewed step, and then produces a final solution-correctness decision. The final decision probability becomes a prefix score; the rationale is an observable verification trace, not a proof.

The supervision recipe uses rejection sampling rather than gold rationales. QwQ-32B-Preview samples four verification chains for each PRM800K-train prefix. A chain is retained only when every required boxed judgment is parseable, every generated judgment agrees with the corresponding human PRM800K step label, the chain is no longer than 4,096 tokens, and the final 1K set remains roughly balanced by prefix correctness. Humans supervise the decision boundary through labels, but they do not validate the wording or faithfulness of the generated critique.

Verifier compute can then scale in two ways. Parallel scaling samples K independent verification CoTs and averages their prefix scores. Sequential scaling extends one verification through distinct prompts such as Let me double check, Let's verify again, and Did I miss something?, asking the model to revise its prior judgment. Best-of-N uses verifier-weighted answer voting, while guided beam search scores candidate partial solutions before expansion.

The feedback contract is judgment-required and model-conditioned. A high score means the trained generative verifier assigns high probability to correctness after its own verification process; it is not a programmatic correctness check, an environment reward, or a model-independent label. Repeated thinking can expose alternative checks, but correlated errors, premature commitment, and step-label interference remain possible.

ThinkPRM把过程验证器从“前缀到标量”的分类器改为可语言化的judge。给定数学题和解答前缀，模型生成长verification CoT，按顺序批评各步骤，为每个已检查步骤输出boxed correct或incorrect判断，最后给出整体解答正确性决策。最终决策概率成为prefix score；rationale是可观察的验证轨迹，而不是证明。

监督配方采用rejection sampling，而不是gold rationale。QwQ-32B-Preview对每个PRM800K-train前缀采样4条验证链。只有当所有所需boxed判断均可解析、每个生成判断都与相应PRM800K人工步骤标签一致、链不超过4,096 token，且最终1K集合在前缀正确性上大致平衡时，样本才被保留。人工标签约束决策边界，但人工并未验证生成批评文字是否正确或忠实。

之后可用两种方式扩展验证器计算。Parallel scaling采样K条独立verification CoT并平均prefix score。Sequential scaling通过Let me double check、Let's verify again和Did I miss something?等不同提示延长同一验证，让模型修订先前判断。Best-of-N使用验证器加权的答案投票，guided beam search则在扩展前为候选部分解答评分。

反馈契约需要模型判断，并受具体模型约束。高分表示训练后的生成式验证器在执行自身验证过程后，对“正确”赋予较高概率；它不是程序化正确性检查、环境reward或模型无关标签。重复思考可能暴露替代检查，但相关错误、过早承诺和step-label interference仍可能存在。

title: Method
方法
html:
Source and raw candidates. The paper samples problem-prefix pairs from the PRM800K train split, which derives from MATH and contains model-generated solutions with human step labels. QwQ-32B-Preview receives the problem, the multi-step prefix, and a fixed instruction to critique each step, emit a boxed label, and stop after the first incorrect step. Four teacher chains are sampled per prefix; the exact sampling temperature and seed ledger are not disclosed in the rendered paper or dataset card.

Filtering and released object. Malformed or missing boxed decisions are discarded, as are chains whose emitted step judgments disagree with any corresponding PRM800K label or exceed 4,096 tokens. Accepted text is normalized by standardizing boxed notation, removing content after the final verification decision, and adding think delimiters. Roughly 20% of raw chains passed the format and label-agreement checks, so about 5,000 generations were needed to obtain 1,000 retained rows. The release contains one 1,000-row train split with problem, prefix, cot, prefix_steps, gt_step_labels, and prefix_label; rejected chains are not included.

Training. The authors train generative PRMs based on DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen 1.5B, 7B, and 14B models and QwQ-32B-Preview using next-token supervised finetuning over complete verification chains. The 1.5B and 7B models use full finetuning for three epochs; 14B variants use three-epoch LoRA and QwQ uses five-epoch LoRA. The paper reports effective batch sizes of 32 for 1.5B/7B and 16 for LoRA runs, plus single-A100 or four-A6000 training setups, but several learning rates and LoRA parameters are missing from the rendered source.

Score extraction and search. At evaluation, ThinkPRM generates a verification chain up to 8,192 tokens, the implementation forces the final correctness query, and the resulting affirmative probability is used as the prefix score. Weighted-majority Best-of-N sums verifier scores for solutions that share a final answer; AIME 2024 directly ranks solutions by verifier score. Guided beam search samples candidate next steps, scores their prefixes, retains the top expansions, and repeats for at most 20 steps in the reported setup.

Verifier scaling and artifacts. Parallel scaling independently samples multiple verification CoTs and averages scores. Sequential scaling uses up to four rounds with different re-check prompts; the repository notes that parallel and sequential modes are not combined. Official artifacts include code and experiment recipes, the public 1K dataset, and ThinkPRM-1.5B/7B/14B model releases. The paper studies 65K process-filtered and 128K outcome-filtered expansions, but those datasets were not verified as part of the public 1K release.

来源与原始候选。论文从PRM800K train split抽取题目-前缀对；PRM800K源于MATH，包含模型生成解答和人工步骤标签。QwQ-32B-Preview接收题目、多步骤前缀和固定指令，按步骤批评、输出boxed标签，并在首个错误步骤后停止。每个前缀采样4条教师链；渲染论文和数据卡没有披露精确采样temperature及seed ledger。

过滤与公开对象。缺失或格式错误的boxed判断被丢弃；若生成步骤判断与任一对应PRM800K标签不一致，或链超过4,096 token，也会被丢弃。接受文本通过统一boxed格式、删除最终验证判断之后的内容以及加入think delimiter来规范化。约20%的原始链通过格式和标签一致性检查，因此获得1,000条保留记录约需5,000次生成。发布物只有一个1,000行train split，字段为problem、prefix、cot、prefix_steps、gt_step_labels和prefix_label；被拒绝链未公开。

训练。作者在完整验证链上执行next-token监督微调，训练基于DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen 1.5B、7B、14B和QwQ-32B-Preview的生成式PRM。1.5B和7B模型采用3个epoch全量微调；14B变体采用3个epoch LoRA，QwQ采用5个epoch LoRA。论文报告1.5B/7B有效batch size为32，LoRA运行有效batch size为16，并给出单A100或四A6000训练设置，但渲染源缺失若干learning rate与LoRA参数。

分数提取与搜索。评估时，ThinkPRM最多生成8,192 token验证链，实现随后强制解码最终正确性询问，并把肯定答案概率用作prefix score。加权多数Best-of-N对共享最终答案的解答累加验证器分数；AIME 2024则直接按验证器分数排序解答。Guided beam search采样候选下一步、为其前缀评分、保留最高分扩展，并在报告设置中重复最多20步。

验证器扩展与artifact。Parallel scaling独立采样多条verification CoT并平均分数；sequential scaling最多使用4轮不同复查提示；仓库说明两种模式不同时使用。官方artifact包括代码和实验recipe、公开1K数据集，以及ThinkPRM-1.5B/7B/14B模型发布。论文还研究65K process-filtered和128K outcome-filtered扩展，但这些数据集未被核验为公开1K发布的一部分。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The strongest direct evidence about the released data is its filtering and measured composition. Every retained generated judgment must agree with PRM800K labels, but this check covers parsed decisions rather than all claims in the critique. The 1K set contains 486 correct and 514 incorrect prefixes from 869 unique questions; its 8,099 step labels are highly imbalanced, with 7,474 positive (92.3%) and 625 negative (7.7%). Verification chains average 1,037 tokens and range from 207 to 3,669 tokens.

ProcessBench measures verifier behavior after training, not intrinsic row quality. On OlympiadBench/OmniMath, the 1.5B base used as LLM-as-a-Judge scores 5.0/5.4 F1 with 51.4%/55.1% bad outputs, while ThinkPRM-1.5B scores 76.3/75.7 with 1.4%/2.4% bad outputs. The 14B comparison moves from 72.8/67.8 to 87.3/85.7 F1, with bad-output rates falling to 2.3% on both subsets. QwQ remains an exception: invalid-output behavior is not uniformly removed by finetuning.

A controlled data ablation supports the use of long verification traces under the tested setup. With the same 1K examples rewritten into short CoTs, 1.5B ProcessBench F1 drops from 87.3/75.7 to 64.8/66.7 and 14B drops from 87.3/85.7 to 55.3/60.8. Process-based filtering of 65K chains also outperforms outcome-based filtering of 128K chains in the reported comparison. These results connect construction choices to downstream verifier behavior, but they do not certify rationale faithfulness.

Test-time results show utility within specific candidate generators and subsets. The paper reports higher or comparable Best-of-N and guided-search curves than matched discriminative and LLM-as-a-Judge baselines, an 8-point advantage over DiscPRM on 86 GPQA-physics questions, a 4.5-point advantage on a 200-problem LiveCodeBench v5 subset, and a 7.2-point token-budget comparison on a ProcessBench subset. Parallel score averaging and sequential re-checking can help, but performance plateaus and the paper finds no universal winner between them.

Scaling the synthetic training set to 65K improves reported MATH-500 curves while reducing some out-of-domain performance. Benchmark gains therefore motivate the verifier and data recipe; they do not prove that every accepted CoT is correct, that the dataset is uncontaminated or properly licensed, or that the verifier score transfers to unseen generators, tasks, and search policies.

关于公开数据最直接的证据来自过滤契约和实测组成。每个保留样本的生成判断都必须与PRM800K标签一致，但该检查只覆盖解析后的决策，不覆盖批评文字中的所有陈述。1K集合来自869个唯一题目，含486个正确前缀和514个错误前缀；其8,099个步骤标签高度不平衡，其中7,474个为正（92.3%），625个为负（7.7%）。验证链平均1,037 token，范围为207至3,669 token。

ProcessBench衡量训练后的验证器行为，而非数据行的内在质量。在OlympiadBench/OmniMath上，1.5B base作为LLM-as-a-Judge时F1为5.0/5.4，bad output比例为51.4%/55.1%；ThinkPRM-1.5B为76.3/75.7，bad output比例降为1.4%/2.4%。14B比较从72.8/67.8升至87.3/85.7 F1，两子集bad output均降至2.3%。QwQ仍是例外：微调并未一致消除其无效输出。

受控数据消融支持在所测设置中使用长验证轨迹。把同一1K样本改写为短CoT后，1.5B的ProcessBench F1从87.3/75.7降至64.8/66.7，14B从87.3/85.7降至55.3/60.8。报告对比中，65K process-based过滤链也优于128K outcome-based过滤链。这些结果把构造选择与下游验证器行为联系起来，但不能认证rationale忠实性。

测试时结果说明它在特定候选生成器与子集上的效用。论文报告Best-of-N和guided-search曲线高于或接近匹配的判别式与LLM-as-a-Judge基线；在86道GPQA-physics题上比DiscPRM高8点，在200题LiveCodeBench v5子集上高4.5点，并在ProcessBench子集的token-budget对比中高7.2点。Parallel分数平均和sequential复查可能有帮助，但性能会平台化，论文也未发现两者之间的通用赢家。

把合成训练集扩至65K可改善报告的MATH-500曲线，却使部分域外性能下降。因此benchmark增益只能支持研究验证器与数据配方；不能证明每条接受CoT都正确、数据集无污染且许可证完备，也不能证明验证器分数能迁移到未见生成器、任务与搜索策略。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The prior baseline is either a discriminative PRM trained on step-label pairs or an untuned LLM-as-a-Judge that verbalizes a decision. The former exposes a scalar but not an audit trace and consumes many labels; the latter exposes a rationale but may not reliably detect errors or emit parseable decisions.

ThinkPRM's specific change is to distill verifier behavior through long, process-filtered synthetic rationales while using human labels only as rejection criteria. This changes the reusable object from a prefix-label pair to a prefix-verification-CoT-label record and lets the verifier spend variable generation compute before producing the scalar score consumed by selection or search.

The direction signal for rollout/search curation is that verifier traces themselves become a test-time data stream. Independent verifier samples, sequential revisions, score aggregation, and beam decisions should therefore be logged alongside candidate solution rollouts. The work also separates process-label agreement from outcome-only filtering and shows that a larger outcome-filtered pool need not produce the better verifier.

What is not new remains important. The paper does not introduce PRM800K, MATH, SFT, LoRA, rejection sampling, generative reward modeling, Best-of-N, beam search, or self-consistency. It does not prove generated critiques are faithful explanations, provide a calibrated universal reward, or show that more verifier tokens always help. Reuse should compare matched discriminative, untuned judge, short-CoT, outcome-filtered, random/majority, and compute-matched controls.

既有基线要么是在步骤标签对上训练的判别式PRM，要么是把决策语言化但未专门训练的LLM-as-a-Judge。前者输出标量但没有审计轨迹，并消耗大量标签；后者输出rationale，却可能无法可靠识别错误或给出可解析决策。

ThinkPRM的具体变化，是通过长、process-filtered合成rationale蒸馏验证器行为，而人工标签只用作拒绝条件。这把可复用对象从“前缀-标签对”变为“前缀-verification CoT-标签记录”，并允许验证器在输出供选择或搜索消费的标量分数之前使用可变生成计算。

它对rollout/search数据整理的方向信号，是验证器轨迹本身成为测试时数据流。独立验证器样本、sequential revision、分数聚合和beam决策都应与候选解答rollout一起记录。该工作还把process-label agreement与仅按outcome过滤区分开，并表明更大的outcome-filtered池不一定训练出更好的验证器。

必须明确哪些并非新贡献。论文没有提出PRM800K、MATH、SFT、LoRA、rejection sampling、generative reward modeling、Best-of-N、beam search或self-consistency；也没有证明生成批评是忠实解释、提供校准的通用reward，或说明更多验证token总会有帮助。复用时应比较匹配的判别式、未微调judge、短CoT、outcome-filtered、随机/多数投票和compute-matched对照。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• Boxed-label agreement is not rationale verification. A chain can emit every expected label while containing incorrect, post-hoc, irrelevant, or unfaithful explanations.
  • PRM800K/MATH prefixes and human labels carry their own ambiguity and annotation error. The release does not provide adjudication confidence or alternative labels for disputed steps.
  • Step labels are 92.3% positive despite roughly balanced prefix outcomes. Prefix F1, scalar scores, and search ranking operate at different granularities and should not be treated as interchangeable quality measures.
  • The dataset has only one 1,000-row train split. It omits upstream PRM800K row IDs, teacher seeds, four-candidate group IDs, raw rejected chains, rejection reasons, and deterministic joins back to source revisions.
  • Exact-match, near-duplicate, and semantic decontamination are unknown for PRM800K/MATH-derived training prompts versus ProcessBench, MATH-500, AIME 2024, GPQA-Diamond, and LiveCodeBench evaluations.
  • The Hugging Face dataset repository added an MIT LICENSE, but its copyright-holder placeholder is unfilled and the notice does not establish coverage or compatibility for PRM800K/MATH-derived inputs and QwQ outputs. A code license and record-level upstream rights ledger remain unavailable.
  • Generative scores can be overconfident and cluster near zero or one. The paper does not establish calibration under changing domains, candidate generators, model revisions, or verifier-compute budgets.
  • Autoregressive verification can prematurely commit. The paper reports step-label interference, where an early incorrect judgment makes later steps more likely to receive the same negative judgment.
  • Verification chains add substantial latency and can loop, overthink, or end without a parseable label. Finetuning reduces these failures but does not eliminate them, and parallel/sequential scaling can plateau.
  • The 65K process-filtered and 128K outcome-filtered expansions are analyzed but were not verified in the public 1K release. More math data improves some in-domain curves while degrading some out-of-domain results.
  • Several sampling, optimization, search, and environment details are missing or incompletely rendered, including data-generation temperature, seeds, some learning rates and LoRA settings, and complete run manifests.
  • Results use selected task subsets and generators. Downstream benchmark improvements do not prove item-level critique correctness, data quality, licensing, contamination safety, or reliable use as an RL reward.

• Boxed标签一致性不等于rationale验证。即便一条链输出所有期望标签，其解释仍可能错误、事后附会、无关或不忠实。
  • PRM800K/MATH前缀和人工标签自身可能存在歧义与标注错误。发布物没有提供争议步骤的裁决置信度或替代标签。
  • 尽管前缀结果大致平衡，步骤标签仍有92.3%为正。前缀F1、标量分数和搜索排序处于不同粒度，不应被视为可互换的质量指标。
  • 数据集只有一个1,000行train split，省略上游PRM800K行ID、教师seed、四候选组ID、原始拒绝链、拒绝原因以及可确定性连接源版本的join。
  • PRM800K/MATH衍生训练提示与ProcessBench、MATH-500、AIME 2024、GPQA-Diamond和LiveCodeBench评估之间的精确、近重复与语义去污染均为unknown。
  • Hugging Face数据仓已加入MIT LICENSE，但版权方占位符尚未填写，且该声明不能证明其覆盖PRM800K/MATH衍生输入与QwQ输出或与上游条款兼容。代码许可证与逐记录上游权利ledger仍不可用。
  • 生成式分数可能过度自信并聚集在0或1附近。论文没有建立跨领域、候选生成器、模型版本或验证计算预算变化的校准结论。
  • 自回归验证可能过早承诺。论文报告step-label interference：早期错误判断会使后续步骤更可能得到同样的负判断。
  • 验证链增加明显延迟，并可能循环、overthink或结束时没有可解析标签。微调减少但没有消除这些失败，parallel/sequential scaling也可能平台化。
  • 论文分析65K process-filtered和128K outcome-filtered扩展，但它们未被核验为公开1K发布的一部分。更多数学数据改善部分域内曲线，却降低部分域外结果。
  • 若干采样、优化、搜索和环境细节缺失或渲染不完整，包括数据生成temperature、seed、部分learning rate与LoRA设置以及完整运行manifest。
  • 结果使用选定任务子集与生成器。下游benchmark提升不能证明逐条批评正确、数据质量、许可证完备、去污染安全或可作为可靠RL reward。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For rollout_search_test_time_trace_data, ThinkPRM provides a concrete example of a second model generating traces that govern the fate of first-model rollouts. Curators should treat the candidate solution, verification CoT, parsed labels, scalar score, aggregation, and search action as separate linked objects rather than collapsing them into one reward number.

An auditable training row should preserve the upstream PRM800K ID and revision, MATH source/split, problem, full solution, selected prefix boundary, human step labels and annotator metadata, teacher checkpoint, all four raw verification candidates, prompt, temperature, seed, token limit, parse result, per-step generated labels, rejection reason, selected CoT, and content hashes. The public six fields retain useful content but not this complete lineage.

An inference record should add the candidate-generator checkpoint and decoding settings, candidate/answer ID, verifier checkpoint and tokenizer, rendered prompt, verification text, stop condition, final forced-decode probabilities, prefix score, parallel sample index or sequential round, trigger phrase, latency, token count, and failure flags. A decision record should retain all candidates, answer grouping, score aggregation, beam state, pruned paths, selected path, and tie-breaking policy.

The 1K release can support verifier SFT reproduction attempts, rationale-versus-label audits, parser robustness studies, score calibration experiments, and controlled re-scoring of fixed candidate pools. It should not be treated as a programmatically verified proof corpus or as evidence that generated critiques are universally correct. Independent mathematical checking is needed wherever wrong process feedback is costly.

For atlas readers, the work clarifies that scaling candidate rollouts and scaling verifier reasoning are distinct compute axes. Benchmark gains support the usefulness of the studied verifier pipeline, while label imbalance, rationale faithfulness, contamination, licensing, and full decision lineage remain independent audit obligations.

对rollout_search_test_time_trace_data而言，ThinkPRM展示了第二个模型如何生成决定第一个模型rollout去留的轨迹。整理者应把候选解答、verification CoT、解析标签、标量分数、聚合与搜索动作视为相互链接的独立对象，而不是压缩为一个reward数字。

可审计训练行应保留上游PRM800K ID与版本、MATH来源/切分、题目、完整解答、所选前缀边界、人工步骤标签与标注者元数据、教师checkpoint、全部4个原始验证候选、prompt、temperature、seed、token上限、解析结果、逐步生成标签、拒绝原因、选中CoT和内容hash。公开六字段保留了有用内容，但没有完整lineage。

推理记录还应加入候选生成器checkpoint与解码设置、候选/答案ID、验证器checkpoint与tokenizer、渲染后prompt、验证文本、停止条件、最终强制解码概率、prefix score、parallel样本索引或sequential轮次、trigger phrase、延迟、token数和失败标记。决策记录应保留全部候选、答案分组、分数聚合、beam state、被剪枝路径、选中路径和tie-breaking策略。

公开1K数据可用于验证器SFT复现尝试、rationale与标签分离审计、parser稳健性研究、分数校准实验，以及对固定候选池的受控重评分。它不应被当作程序化验证的证明语料，也不能证明生成批评普遍正确。在错误过程反馈代价较高时，需要独立数学检查。

对atlas读者而言，该工作说明扩展候选rollout与扩展验证器推理是两条不同计算轴。Benchmark增益支持所研究验证流程的效用，但标签不平衡、rationale忠实性、污染、许可证和完整决策lineage仍是相互独立的审计义务。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• The public object is 1,000 PRM800K/MATH prefixes paired with QwQ-32B-Preview verification CoTs and human step labels, not 1,000 independently human-verified rationales.
  • Four teacher chains are sampled per prefix; about 5,000 raw generations yield 1,000 retained chains after format, all-step agreement, length, and balance filters.
  • The release has 869 unique questions and 8,099 step labels, 92.3% of which are positive despite roughly balanced prefix outcomes.
  • ThinkPRM's scalar is a generative judgment probability after a verification trace, not a programmatic correctness predicate.
  • Parallel scaling averages independent verifier scores; sequential scaling revisits one judgment, and neither mode is guaranteed to improve monotonically.
  • Audit rationale faithfulness, upstream IDs, rejected candidates, decontamination, licenses, 65K release boundaries, and complete model/search revisions separately from benchmark gains.

• 公开对象是1,000个PRM800K/MATH前缀及其QwQ-32B-Preview验证CoT和人工步骤标签，不是1,000条经过独立人工验证的rationale。
  • 每个前缀采样4条教师链；约5,000次原始生成经过格式、全步骤一致性、长度和平衡过滤后得到1,000条保留链。
  • 发布物含869个唯一题目和8,099个步骤标签；尽管前缀结果大致平衡，步骤标签仍有92.3%为正。
  • ThinkPRM标量是在生成验证轨迹后得到的判断概率，不是程序化正确性predicate。
  • Parallel scaling平均独立验证器分数，sequential scaling复查同一判断；两种方式都不能保证单调改进。
  • 应把rationale忠实性、上游ID、拒绝候选、去污染、许可证、65K发布边界及完整模型/搜索版本与benchmark增益分开审计。

value.html: The public 1K dataset samples problem-prefix pairs from the PRM800K train split, which is based on MATH. The final set contains 1,000 prefixes from 869 unique questions, approximately balanced by overall prefix correctness.

The Hugging Face train split contains 1,000 rows with problem, prefix, cot, prefix_steps, gt_step_labels, and prefix_label. The verification CoT contains critiques and boxed step judgments, while prefix_label is true only when every labeled step is correct.

QwQ-32B-Preview generates four verification chains per sampled prefix. Each chain critiques successive solution steps and emits boxed correct/incorrect judgments; accepted chains are synthetic teacher outputs, not human-written rationales.

Offline generative verification of solution prefixes. ThinkPRM produces a verification CoT and a final correctness probability, which can score ProcessBench prefixes, weight Best-of-N answer votes, rank beam-search expansions, or be aggregated across parallel or sequential verifier calls.

A judgment-requiring generative PRM. At inference it generates up to 8,192 verification tokens, then the implementation obtains a prefix score from the forced final correctness query. Parallel scaling averages scores from independent verification CoTs; sequential scaling prompts the verifier to revisit its earlier judgment.

During data construction, retain a chain only if every required boxed step judgment is parseable and matches the corresponding PRM800K label, the chain is at most 4,096 tokens, and the accepted set remains roughly balanced by overall prefix correctness. During use, the resulting scalar prefix score ranks or prunes candidate solutions rather than proving correctness.
ThinkPRM variants are trained from DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen 1.5B, 7B and 14B models and QwQ-32B-Preview. The official repository releases ThinkPRM-1.5B, ThinkPRM-7B and ThinkPRM-14B checkpoints.
QwQ-32B-Preview generates the 1K public synthetic verification chains; PRM800K human step labels are the rejection-filter reference rather than rationale supervision.

For each PRM800K train problem-prefix pair, QwQ-32B-Preview is prompted to critique steps in order, emit a boxed correct/incorrect label for each reviewed step, and stop after the first incorrect step.

Sample four teacher chains per prefix until 1,000 chains pass the filters. The paper reports that roughly 20% of initial samples satisfy the format and label-agreement criteria, requiring about 5,000 raw generations for the public 1K set. Rejected samples and their reasons are not released.
unknown

Reject malformed or missing boxed decisions, any chain whose generated judgments disagree with PRM800K ground-truth labels, and chains longer than 4,096 tokens. Standardize boxed notation, remove content after the final verification decision, add think delimiters, and approximately balance correct versus incorrect prefixes.

Data-generation chains are capped at 4,096 tokens. Verification at evaluation allows up to 8,192 generated tokens. Parallel scaling samples multiple independent verifier CoTs and averages scores; sequential scaling uses up to four rounds with distinct re-verification trigger phrases. Exact total FLOPs and wall-clock budgets for every experiment are not disclosed.

The 1.5B and 7B variants use full finetuning for three epochs; 14B variants use three-epoch LoRA and QwQ-32B-Preview uses five-epoch LoRA. Reported effective batch sizes are 32 for 1.5B/7B and 16 for the LoRA runs. The paper reports one A100 80GB for the 14B/QwQ runs and four RTX A6000 48GB GPUs for 1.5B/7B, but some LoRA ranks and learning rates are missing from the rendered HTML and must remain unknown here.

The released set contains 1,000 QwQ-32B-Preview verification CoTs over PRM800K-train mathematical problem-prefix pairs from 869 unique questions. It has 486 correct and 514 incorrect prefixes, 7,474 positive and 625 negative step labels, and verification chains ranging from 207 to 3,669 tokens. A separate 65K process-filtered expansion is studied but was not verified as part of the public 1K release.

Hugging Face exposes one 1,000-row train split and no validation or test split. Evaluation uses ProcessBench, a 100-problem MATH-500 subset, AIME 2024, 86 GPQA-Diamond physics questions, and a 200-problem LiveCodeBench v5 subset; the exact benchmark item lists and run manifests are not all stored with the dataset.

unknown. The paper and dataset card do not publish exact-match, near-duplicate, or semantic-overlap ledgers between PRM800K/MATH-derived training prompts and ProcessBench, MATH-500, AIME 2024, GPQA-Diamond, or LiveCodeBench evaluation items.

items: Exact agreement between generated boxed judgments and PRM800K labels does not verify that every natural-language critique is factually correct, faithful, or causally responsible for the judgment.

The public rows omit an upstream PRM800K record identifier, teacher-generation seed, raw candidate IDs, rejected chains, rejection reasons, and per-record model/config revision, limiting deterministic lineage reconstruction.

Positive step labels comprise 92.3% of released step labels even though prefix correctness is roughly balanced; accuracy, F1, prefix scores, and search behavior therefore reflect different class and aggregation contracts.
Generative PRM scores can be overconfident and cluster near zero or one; the paper does not establish calibration across domains, model sizes, or changing candidate generators.
Step-label interference can propagate an early verification mistake to later steps, and autoregressive generation can prematurely commit to an incorrect judgment.

Long verifier generations can loop, overthink, omit parseable labels, or consume substantially more inference compute than discriminative PRMs; finetuning reduces but does not eliminate invalid outputs, especially for QwQ.

Parallel and sequential verifier scaling depend on sampling temperature, trigger phrases, round count, and token budget; the paper finds no universal winner, and additional verifier compute can plateau.
The 65K math expansion improves reported MATH-500 results but can reduce out-of-domain performance, so more synthetic data is not evidence of universally better verifier data.

Benchmark gains under ProcessBench, Best-of-N, and guided search do not establish item-level rationale correctness, absence of contamination, license compatibility, or robustness outside the evaluated generators and tasks.

The public dataset has only a train split; no held-out validation split, immutable release tag, signed checksum manifest, or complete software/environment lockfile is attached as a data audit package.

value.html: The Hugging Face dataset repository added an MIT LICENSE on 2026-04-18, but its copyright-holder placeholder remains unfilled. The release does not clarify whether MIT covers only repository material or also the PRM800K/MATH-derived inputs and QwQ-generated outputs; record-level upstream compatibility therefore remains unknown. A code license was not verified.

PRM800K-train provides a problem, model-generated solution prefix, and human step labels; QwQ-32B-Preview generates four candidate verification CoTs per prefix; format, length, process-label agreement, and class-balance filters select 1,000 chains; standardized rows retain the source text, synthetic CoT, parsed prefix steps, ground-truth labels, and overall label; SFT produces generative PRMs whose final correctness probabilities drive verification and search.
